title: The diagonal of a morphism of schemes is an immersion
statement: For every morphism of schemes $f:X\to Y$ [def-pc-scheme], the diagonal $\Delta_f:X\to X\times_YX$ into the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] is an immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion].
